description:
AI SQL assistant that works on your real schema. Generate, explain, fix and optimize SQL, and let Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT query your database over MCP.

Natural language to SQL: Translate plain text into queries. Query optimization: Suggests better query structures. Supports multiple DBs: MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc. Real-time feedback: Validate queries instantly.
